basic_profile.bio: Based in Melbourne, I am a 34-year-old professional pet sitter with a deep passion for all things furry and feathered. When I'm not taking care of pets, I enjoy writing fiction and exploring new cafes around the city. A tech enthusiast at heart, I also dabble in graphic design projects for local businesses. I usually browse Reddit during my downtime in the afternoons and late evenings. Currently in a long-term relationship, I cherish spending weekends with my partner exploring hiking trails and trying out new recipes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Animal Behavior and have over a decade of experience in pet care. My expertise is largely self-taught, supplemented with various online courses and workshops. Participating actively in pet-sitting communities has equipped me with a nuanced understanding of industry practices and client management.
